summary: Comprehensive testing of Realtouch Invoice Admin Portal, Forgot Password, and new user signup features. Backend: 25/26 tests passed (96%). Frontend: All UI features working correctly. Fixed frontend bug where Settings page showed hardcoded default company details instead of empty values for new users.

minor.issue: Intermittent 500 error on first call (likely MongoDB upsert timing issue)
minor.note: Works on retry - may be first-time initialization

fixed_issues.issue: Hardcoded default company details ('Realtouch Global Ventures Ltd', '16578193') in form state instead of empty values
fixed_issues.fix: Changed default values to empty strings to match backend behavior for new users

backend: Owner login successful with is_owner=True flag
GET /api/admin/stats returns system stats (total_users, total_invoices, revenue, etc.)
GET /api/admin/users returns user list without password_hash
POST /api/auth/forgot-password returns reset_token (email service not configured)
POST /api/auth/signup creates user with empty company_details.name
Invoice CRUD flow (create, read, update, delete)
frontend: Landing page loads correctly
Login page shows email/password form
Owner login redirects to dashboard
Dashboard shows 'Admin Portal' button for owner user
Dashboard shows 'Owner Access' badge for owner user
Admin Portal loads at /admin for owner
Admin Portal Overview tab shows system stats (Total Users, Total Invoices, Revenue, Downloads)
Admin Portal Overview shows Plan Distribution
Admin Portal Users tab shows user list with search
Admin Portal Users tab shows plan dropdown for each user
Admin Portal Feature Controls tab shows limits and pricing inputs
Admin Portal Feature Controls shows feature toggles
Admin Portal PDF Templates tab shows 5 templates
Admin Portal PDF Templates has Add/Edit Template form
Settings page does NOT show 'Production Deployment Guide' section
Settings page shows Profile Information, Company Logo, Company Details, PDF Template, Subscription sections
Non-owner user dashboard does NOT show Admin Portal button
Non-owner user dashboard does NOT show Owner Access badge
Non-owner user redirected from /admin to /dashboard
Forgot Password link visible on login page
Forgot Password form shows email input and Send Reset Link button

critical_code_review_comments: Google OAuth console warning: 'The given origin is not allowed for the given client ID' - Google Cloud Console needs to be updated with the preview domain
seed_data_creation: Test users created during testing with prefix 'test_signup_', 'test_reset_'
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new Admin Portal features tested and working: (1) System Overview with stats, (2) User Management with plan updates, (3) Payment Transactions list, (4) Feature Controls with toggles and pricing, (5) PDF Templates management. Forgot Password flow works end-to-end. New user signup correctly creates users with empty company_details. Fixed frontend bug where SettingsPage.jsx had hardcoded default company details. Stripe uses test key, Resend uses placeholder key (emails not sent, reset_token returned directly).

mocked_apis.Stripe: Uses test key sk_test_emergent - checkout sessions created but not real payments
mocked_apis.Resend: Uses placeholder key re_demo_key - emails not actually sent, reset_token returned directly
mocked_apis.Google OAuth: Requires real Google account and proper domain configuration in Google Cloud Console
